What you got to understand is, big corporations like Samsung, Apple, Google, etc are already established with their infrastructure. So they can design and build phones with the latest silicon chip, better battery life, polished software, etc.. for a lot cheaper than smaller companies. 

The Nothing brand have had to start from ground zero and build up an audience whilst producing something different. They’re not there yet to be able to provide something on the level of its competitors at their price point.. as they’re unable to buy in at the same quantity or have the infrastructure to save costs..
